highlights: Whole School Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy
Designated Safeguarding Leads (DSL) on each campus
Basic medical care insurance included for all boarders
Air Quality Policy addressing indoor and outdoor environments
Sun Safety Policy and Thunder & Lightning Strike Policy
safety.policy_summary: Bromsgrove International School Thailand maintains a comprehensive Safeguarding and Child Protection Policy acknowledging moral and statutory responsibilities to safeguard and promote the welfare of all pupils. The policy outlines clear roles and responsibilities for Designated Safeguarding Leads (DSLs) across campuses, standard staff codes of conduct, and reporting procedures for concerns and complaints.
